The forecast quicker ground would be a concern for Miletus and this trip is an unknown for Man Of Desert. Three-time course winner Gorgeous Mr George (second choice) may be able to bounce back from a lesser effort on today's return but MISTER MOJITO is just preferred in his bid to make it 3-3 over C&D. Rogue Allegiance is without a win since his debut but ran well on his first start for Jack Jones, while Grabajabba and Candonomore are also considered.
